title: Ranked trade setups
description: Reply to prompts/trade_entries.md: up to three trade setups derived from one reversal-zones input and projection, prices from zone edges and odds counted on simulated paths, ranked by edge per order. A failed precondition, or no valid setup, is reported as {task, error} instead.

rules.description: Version of the setup rules. 2: odds counted on simulated paths. Files without it were written by version 1 (odds from reach and turn by formulas) and are not checked against version 2.

time.description: The projection's as_of.time, ISO 8601 with offset.

valid_until.description: The projection's horizon.last. The setups mean nothing after it.

probability.description: What the projection's reach and turn measure (the input's want.probability). The setups' own odds always count touches of daily highs and lows.

move.description: One candle's typical move: price x volatility.assumed[0].

buffer.description: Gap between a stop and its zone edge: 0.25 x move.

range.description: Typical distance travelled by the end of the horizon.

entries.description: Best first, by edge.per_order, whatever its sign. Fewer than three only when fewer are valid. When no valid setup has a positive edge, confidence.limits says so.

note.description: States that the setups are hypothetical and not a recommendation.

fill.description: Share of the simulated paths on which the entry order fills by valid_until.

win_if_filled.description: Share of the filled paths that reach the target before the stop (a day reaching both counts as the stop).

basis.description: Where the odds come from: the simulated paths, and the shares that end at the target, at the stop, or still open.

if_filled.description: Mean result of the filled simulated paths, in units of risk: -1 at the stop, +ratio at the target, the last close against the entry when still open.

per_order.description: fill x if_filled: the same, counting orders that never fill as zero. The ranking key.

quality.description: From edge.if_filled: favourable at +0.05 or more, unfavourable at -0.05 or less, marginal between.

watch.description: Zones in the way and events that can hurt the setup. May be empty.

anchor.description: The zone edge the price comes from, with the buffer when one is applied.
